situation: Opening, both fighters squared up (vs Anti-hero)
line: I'll go easy. ...I'll try.

situation: Her guard is closing in around him (vs Empress)
line: Leave them out of it. Leave everyone out of it. It's you and me.

situation: The Cyborg has just eaten a civilian (vs Cyborg)
line: That's the last one. I'll help what's left once I'm done with you.

situation: The opponent is aiming a blast at a town
line: Touch that town and I'll stop being nice.

situation: Mid-fight, the opponent has gone quiet
line: I've got a lot more where that came from.

situation: A new guard member tags in (vs Empress)
line: Send them all. I'll get through every one, and then I'll get to you.

situation: The Cyborg's chest hatch has just flipped open (vs Cyborg)
line: There's the hatch. I'm going to hit it.

situation: The opponent is backing away across the sea (vs Anti-hero)
line: Run if you want. I'll follow. I'm not tired.

situation: Inside the fold, just the two of them
line: Nobody's watching. Nobody's hurt. Everything I've got is yours.

situation: After a long taunt about her empire (vs Empress)
line: You can call it what you like. It ends here.

situation: The opponent is on the brink and staggering
line: Stay down. Please. I really don't want to hit you again.

situation: He has been pressing for a full minute
line: Twelve years of morning stairs, and I'm still only warming up!

situation: The opponent's blows keep bouncing off his guard
line: You can't break what won't bend!

situation: A long, even stretch of the fight
line: I could do this all week.

situation: He has just landed three hits in a row (vs Anti-hero)
line: That's what a whole life of practice looks like.

situation: The opponent has slowed down
line: Is that all? I was ready for more.

situation: He just dodged a big beam
line: Missed me! I'll hit you next time.

situation: He is grinning after a heavy hit (vs Empress)
line: Nobody hits harder than me when I'm smiling.

situation: The Cyborg has just offered him a menu (vs Cyborg)
line: You want a menu? Try my fist.

situation: Early on, feeling good (vs Anti-hero)
line: I've been dreaming about this fight for years.

situation: About to use a special
line: Watch this one. I've been saving it.

situation: The opponent is breathing hard, he is not
line: I'm not even out of breath.

situation: A clean heavy hit lands
line: There it is!

situation: A hit he has been waiting for (vs Anti-hero)
line: That's the one. Thank you.

situation: He lands a hit the opponent respects (vs Anti-hero)
line: Good hit. Feel that? That's respect.

situation: A quick counter
line: Ha! Gotcha.

situation: He steps on the opponent's cape (vs Empress)
line: Sorry, that was mine.

situation: A fast exchange ends
line: Okay. Okay okay okay.

situation: The opponent lands a good hit on him
line: Not bad. Not bad at all.

situation: A short lull between exchanges
line: Time out? No? Fine.

situation: Something goes exactly right
line: This is the best day.

situation: A body blow lands on his ribs (vs Cyborg)
line: Oof. Right on the ribs.

situation: An early hit (vs Anti-hero)
line: Nice. I'll remember that one.

situation: The opponent has been turtling for a minute
line: Guard, guard, guard. I like the wall. I'll knock it down.

situation: The opponent is waiting for him to tire (vs Anti-hero)
line: You're waiting for me to tire. Good plan. Bad plan.

situation: The opponent is hiding behind his arms
line: Come out, friend! I promise not to be gentle.

situation: The opponent is rushing him non-stop (vs Anti-hero)
line: You're crowding me! I love it!

situation: The opponent will not stop pressing
line: He never stops. Fine. Neither do I.

situation: The opponent is furious and sloppy (vs Anti-hero)
line: Angry gets sloppy. Come on.

situation: The opponent keeps flying away
line: Hey! Come back! I've barely started!

situation: The opponent is leading him somewhere (vs Empress)
line: He's leaving on purpose. Why?

situation: The opponent has dodged for a full minute
line: Running? That's a first.

situation: The opponent has fired three big beams
line: Big beam again? Let's see if you can hit me with it.

situation: The opponent uses nothing but signatures (vs Cyborg)
line: One beam, one beam, one beam. Do you have anything else?

situation: The opponent is saving everything for a big shot
line: You're saving it all for the big shot. I can see it coming.

situation: Crowd watches from a distance, mood is calm
line: Don't mind them. They're just watching. ...Hi, everybody.

situation: A civilian is thrown clear by a blast
line: Got you. Stay low.

situation: He said: 'You were always worried.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: Somebody has to be.

situation: He said: 'I do not make faces.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: Ha! You just did.

situation: She said: 'Petitioner...' (vs Empress)
line: Petition denied. I'm not signing anything.

situation: He said: 'Please rate your experience.' (vs Cyborg)
line: One star. Still hungry.

situation: She said: 'Guard, present arms!' (vs Empress)
line: Cute. Do they salute or do they fight?

situation: He said: 'Fifth. Behind the goons.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: The goons?! They're not even here!

situation: He said: 'May I speak to your manager?' (vs Cyborg)
line: I'm the manager today.

situation: He said: 'You were adequate.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: Adequate! High praise.

situation: She said: 'We will attend presently.' (vs Empress)
line: Take your time. I brought snacks.

situation: He said: 'Take your moment. You will need it.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: Thanks. I'll use every second.

situation: The opponent said: 'You talk a lot.'
line: You noticed.

situation: He said: 'Filth.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: Careful. I've heard worse from my dog.

situation: She said: 'You struck ME.' (vs Empress)
line: Yeah, I did.

situation: He said: 'Under new management.' (vs Cyborg)
line: Same management. Same face.

situation: He said: 'You were adequate.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: I'll take adequate. You're a bad judge.

situation: The opponent mocked the people he protects
line: Say that about them once more. Just once.

situation: She said: 'Ohoho. Cute.' (vs Empress)
line: Yeah? Keep laughing. I like it.

situation: He said: 'You will never beat me.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: I might. I'd like to find out.

situation: He said: 'Your input is on the menu.' (vs Cyborg)
line: Make it a small one.

situation: She said: 'You dare laugh at the train?' (vs Empress)
line: It's a very nice train.

situation: He said: 'Sulker.' (vs Anti-hero)
line: I'm not sulking. I'm concentrating.

situation: The opponent said: 'Is that all you've got?'
line: Not even close.

situation: The opponent said: 'You fight like you're afraid.'
line: I am. Of what I'll break. Keep going.

situation: A taunt, a boxer's shuffle, 1 second
line: Is that all? I hope not.

situation: A taunt, a boxer's shuffle, 1 second
line: I'm just getting warm.

situation: A taunt, a boxer's shuffle, 1 second
line: Go on. Show me more.

situation: A taunt, a boxer's shuffle, 1 second
line: Again. That one was fun.

situation: He has been guarding for 20 seconds
line: Only a little longer...

situation: A quiet stretch, the opponent holding back (vs Anti-hero)
line: He's holding back. So am I.

situation: After knocking down a tower
line: I keep breaking things. I'll say sorry in a minute.

situation: Pressing hard and winning
line: Don't stop. Don't give him room.

situation: The town is right below the fight (vs Empress)
line: I can't lose this one. There are people under us.

situation: The opponent is his old friend (vs Anti-hero)
line: He's still my friend. That's what makes it hard.

situation: Her guard keeps rotating in (vs Empress)
line: What is she hiding behind all those guards?

situation: Charging a special
line: Almost there... almost...

situation: The opponent leaves a gap
line: His left side's open. Don't look at it.

situation: A pause after a heavy exchange
line: Breathe.

situation: The last civilian has just fled
line: Everyone's out. Good. Now I can really go.

situation: The opponent keeps turtling and he is losing patience
line: Come on. Come on. Come out.

situation: He has just taken a very hard hit and is still up
line: Still here. Good. That's good.

situation: His arm has just broken
line: That was my arm. It was a good arm.

situation: His arm is broken, he keeps fighting (vs Anti-hero)
line: Okay. My arm's gone. That's fine. I've got another.

situation: A sharp hit lands
line: Ow.

situation: A heavy hit to the ribs (vs Cyborg)
line: Ha! My ribs. I'll need those later.

situation: His leg gives way mid-flight
line: Knee's gone. I'll walk it off. ...Flying it off.

situation: A hit to the head, his vision blurs (vs Anti-hero)
line: Ah. That's my head. It's ringing.

situation: The fight slows and he takes a moment
line: That one's going to hurt tomorrow.

situation: After a long stretch of hits to his hands (vs Empress)
line: I can't feel my fingers. That's new.

situation: Two regions are badly hurt
line: Broken. Definitely broken. Okay. Moving on.

situation: A blast catches him off guard
line: Owwww.

situation: He is badly hurt but grinning (vs Anti-hero)
line: That's the worst I've felt in years. Thanks!

situation: His arm is barely holding
line: Stay with me, arm. Just a little longer.

situation: He is on the brink
line: Hold on. Hold on. I've got one more.

situation: He is on the brink and reeling (vs Anti-hero)
line: Not yet. I'll be fine in a minute.

situation: He survives a finisher
line: Ha! Nope. Not today.

situation: He has taken a long beating (vs Empress)
line: I've been careful all night. I'm done being careful.

situation: He is down and getting up
line: Give me a second. Then I'll take it back.

situation: The opponent thinks it is over (vs Cyborg)
line: You thought that was it? Cute.

situation: A big surge after a break
line: Everything. Right now.

situation: He is knocked flat and rises (vs Anti-hero)
line: I'm getting up. I'm always getting up.

situation: The opponent has just hit him very hard
line: Okay, that got my attention.

situation: He is behind and smiling
line: I'm not done. I'm barely started.

situation: A short rest, then back in
line: Again. Once more.

situation: He was hit while taunting
line: Ow! Fair.

situation: He was hit while taunting
line: Ha! I asked for that.

situation: A bridge has just fallen
line: Sorry about the bridge! I'll help fix it once we're done.

situation: A roof collapses under a blast
line: That was somebody's roof. I'll help rebuild it once I'm done here.

situation: A whole street of houses is gone (vs Empress)
line: ...That was a lot of houses. I'll help fix them once I'm done with you. All of them.

situation: He realises what he's been hitting
line: I wasn't looking. I'm looking now. I'll do better.

situation: The streets are filling with people running
line: Everybody out! I'll deal with this in a second.

situation: An evacuation begins
line: They're getting out! Good.

situation: A home falls, he sees it (vs Empress)
line: That was a home.

situation: A building he was protecting has just fallen
line: I did that. That was me.

situation: A blast is heading for a village (vs Cyborg)
line: Not there. Not over there. Please.

situation: Casualties rise in the city
line: I'll fix every one. I promise. Just... one second.

situation: After a terrible hit on a crowd
line: Sorry. Sorry. Sorry.

situation: The last civilian has just fled
line: That's everyone out. I'll say sorry to the city later.

situation: The city is empty
line: Empty. All of it. Nobody's here.

situation: The Anti-hero is transforming and he waits, arms folded (impatient)
line: Any day now. I'd love you at your best, but I'd also love a fight.

situation: The Anti-hero is transforming (polite)
line: Take all the time you need. I want the real you.

situation: The Anti-hero is transforming (mocking)
line: You're doing the face again. The 'this is very important' face.

situation: The Empress is transforming (impatient)
line: Get on with it.

situation: The Cyborg is transforming (mocking)
line: Under new management? You look the same to me.

situation: Another Protagonist is transforming (polite)
line: Take your time. I'll wait. I'd want you to.

situation: The first rung of Hot Blood begins
line: Okay. Warm.

situation: The second rung (vs Anti-hero)
line: That's a lot. That's... a lot.

situation: The third rung
line: Hold on. Hold on. I'll be fine in a minute.

situation: His heart is racing
line: I can hear my own heart. It's going to be loud.

situation: The opponent waits, arms folded (vs Anti-hero)
line: Don't wait for me. Do your worst. I'll catch up.

situation: Steam starts pouring off him
line: Whoa. Whoa. Steam. Is that me?

situation: A long transformation begins (vs Empress)
line: Give me a second. It's a long one.

situation: The second rung, feeling it
line: Simmering. Great. Wonderful.

situation: He knows what this will cost
line: This is going to hurt. I'm doing it anyway.

situation: The last rung (vs Cyborg)
line: Boiling. Okay. Okay okay okay.

situation: He is a little unsure
line: It's fine. It's fine. I've done this before. Once.

situation: He starts his signature (a placeholder move name)
line: Keeper's Lance!

situation: He starts his signature, short form
line: Lance!

situation: He starts his finisher
line: Everything!

situation: The finisher lands on a friendly rival (vs Anti-hero)
line: That's it. That's the one. Thank you.

situation: The moment before a finisher (vs Anti-hero)
line: Ready? ...Everything!

situation: A warm, respectful finisher
line: Hold still, friend. This is the best one.

situation: A grim finisher against a world-ender (vs Empress)
line: It ends here. Nobody else pays for you.

situation: A grim finisher, with regret (vs Cyborg)
line: I'm sorry. I'm not stopping.

situation: The blast gathers
line: Everything. All of it. Now.

situation: The opponent survives the finisher (vs Anti-hero)
line: You're kidding! ...Good. Again!

situation: The opponent survives, and he is scared (vs Cyborg)
line: No. Stay down. Please stay down.

situation: The final blow is coming
line: Last one. Promise.

situation: The opponent goes down for good (vs Anti-hero)
line: I'll carry you home after.

situation: The camera pushes in on him
line: Right. This is going to be big.

situation: Crater-landing entrance, the match is about to start
line: Okay. Here I am.

situation: Crater-landing entrance
line: Hope I didn't scare anyone. I scared myself.

situation: Staredown before the first blow (vs Anti-hero)
line: You look exactly the same.

situation: Staredown before the first blow (vs Empress)
line: Whatever you're planning, I'll stop it.

situation: Staredown before the first blow (vs Cyborg)
line: Nobody's on the menu today.

situation: Staredown before the first blow (vs anyone)
line: Ready when you are.

situation: His free last signature is ready at the brink
line: One more.

situation: The match ends, he won (vs Anti-hero)
line: Best fight of my year. Rest. I'll carry you home.

situation: The match ends, he won
line: Thank you. I mean it. Come back when you're ready.

situation: A close win (vs Anti-hero)
line: You almost had me at the bridge.

situation: The match ends, the land is wrecked
line: Good fight, friend. Now, let me help fix the hill I broke.

situation: The opponent wants a rematch (vs Anti-hero)
line: Again? ...Tomorrow. Tomorrow, I promise.

situation: A spectacular finish
line: That was incredible. Can we do that again?

situation: The world-ender is beaten (vs Empress)
line: It's over. Nobody else pays for you.

situation: The opponent doesn't get up
line: Are you okay? Say something.

situation: A long, tiring fight
line: Whew. I need a nap.

situation: The dust clears, he stands
line: I won. Wow. Okay.

situation: The opponent gave everything (vs Anti-hero)
line: Nice try. Really.

situation: The match ends, the winner stands in the wreckage
line: Okay. Nobody's hurt. ...Everybody's okay.

situation: The match ends, he lost (vs Anti-hero)
line: Ha! Okay. Okay, you got me. I'll be better.

situation: A loss he respects
line: That was a good one. I'll remember that one.

situation: The opponent stopped right on time (vs Anti-hero)
line: Thank you for not stopping. I'll be back.

situation: He can barely move
line: I'm sore in places I didn't know I had. Wonderful.

situation: On the ground, catching his breath
line: Give me a minute. Then I'll take it back.

situation: The finisher lands on him
line: I lost. Huh.

situation: The Cyborg has won, people are in danger (vs Cyborg)
line: Stay away from them.

situation: The Empress has won, he is grim (vs Empress)
line: I'll... stop you. I'll stop you.

situation: A blunt, quiet loss
line: Well. That happened.

situation: As the screen fades
line: Next time.

situation: A clean loss to a better fighter (vs Anti-hero)
line: You were better today.

situation: The match ends, he lost, the planet is scarred
line: I'll fix it. I'll fix all of it. Give me a week.
